column2: That permanent's controller chooses whether to put it on the top or bottom of the library
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text (transcription error; ruling-conflicts-3, case 1; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2022-04-29 ruling has the permanent's controller choose top or bottom, where the Oracle text has its owner choose ('The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.'). Origin: the card's own note in the Streets of New Capenna Release Notes (2022-04-20; ormos mirror, Wayback capture 2022-04-23), word for word but for 'owner': 'That permanent's owner chooses whether to put it on the top or bottom of the library.' Every ruling on the same instruction (Aether Gust, Moonsnare Prototype, Desynchronize, Unlucky Drop, Sudden Setback and others, 2019 to 2026) has the owner choose. The ruling's last sentence agrees with the card and stays cited. Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.

column2: that permanent's controller puts all of them on the top or all of them on the bottom
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text (transcription error; ruling-conflicts-3, case 1; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): as in the ruling's first sentence, 'controller' where the Oracle text has the owner put the permanent into their library; the Streets of New Capenna Release Notes (2022-04-20) say 'that permanent's owner puts all of them on the top or all of them on the bottom'. That all of a melded or mutated permanent's cards go on top or all on the bottom agrees with the card and is tested (tests/rulings/r_p140_tuck.rs). Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
